definition: Effective completion target becomes later than its cutoff value within months t+1 through t+3; project must be observed at t+3.
data_quality: Observable publication outcome, but 447 later revised-target transitions occur in March 2026 and require source-semantic audit.

definition: Effective completion target becomes later than its cutoff value within months t+1 through t+6; project must be observed at t+6.
data_quality: Longer horizon reduces eligible rows because the dataset spans only 16 months.

definition: Effective completion target changes in either direction within months t+1 through t+3; project must be observed at t+3.
data_quality: Includes accelerations and corrections, so it is not a pure delay outcome.

definition: At t+3 the project remains in the ongoing-project list and the target known at cutoff is earlier than the t+3 report month.
data_quality: Measures continued listing after a known target, not authoritative actual completion delay.

definition: Effective project cost increases above its cutoff value within months t+1 through t+3; project must be observed at t+3.
data_quality: Sensitive to corrections and revised-cost fields appearing after prior blanks.

definition: Effective project cost increases above its cutoff value within months t+1 through t+6; project must be observed at t+6.
data_quality: Longer horizon reduces eligible rows and includes small administrative changes.

definition: Effective project cost increases by at least 5% over its cutoff value within months t+1 through t+6; project must be observed at t+6.
data_quality: Meaningful threshold, but 77 of 145 observed >5% monthly transitions occur in July 2026 and require source-semantic audit.

definition: Among observations at or below 1.10 revised/original cost ratio at cutoff, ratio first exceeds 1.10 within t+1 through t+6; project observed at t+6.
data_quality: Excludes projects already over 10% at cutoff; depends on stable original cost reporting.
